tasks.short: Confer with coworkers about safety and work needs

steps.what: Check the actual site work instruction, safety notice and assigned cutting-height requirement
inputs: Actual safety notices and cutting-height requirements
outputs: Current instruction ready for the work discussion

steps.what: Confer with other workers about actual safety issues, cutting heights and work needs
outputs: Shared understanding of work needs and unresolved issues raised with the supervisor

tasks.design: Put the existing current site instruction at a stable location in {DOCS} for quick lookup. Keep the actual worker discussion and judgment about changing site conditions in person.
tasks.previous_blocker: A worker may have to search through older site instructions before a real work discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document pinning and version labels can make the existing instruction easier to find.
tasks.still_hard: Work needs and safety concerns depend on actual conditions and what coworkers observe.
tasks.human_edge: Workers notice discrepancies and reach an accurate shared understanding.

ambition.what: Reduce instruction retrieval in existing work discussions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document pinning and version labels can reduce searching for a current site instruction.

assumptions: Unmeasured discussion episode including actual instruction retrieval; shares are independent of the prompt prior. If workers already have the instruction at hand, there is no retrieval saving.
The supervisor maintains the actual site instruction. s1 counts the worker's lookup and current-version check; no new clean safety content is assumed.

The actual output is the discussion. No separate report, message, work-order change or post-conversation record is established, so none is invented. A different episode with an actual required record would need that work shown explicitly.
No new instruction or operational authority is generated. Gross 3 minus 1 focal upkeep gives 2 net per 100 baseline focal hours.
unknowns: Whether instruction searching occurs during these discussions
research_questions: Do workers already carry the current instruction?

incremental.description: Maintain the worker's current-document shortcut and check it after site changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 15 times 20% = 3 gross, minus 1 upkeep = 2 net. Actual discussion time is retained in full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain tree marking and measuring tallies

steps.what: Examine and count actual trees during the assigned marking or measuring effort
inputs: Actual assigned plot and tree marking or measuring criteria
outputs: Actual observed tree counts and categories

steps.what: Capture each actual tree tally with its plot and required marking or measurement category
inputs: OPS_SYSTEM: existing field tally form or forest inventory application
outputs: Captured tally entries linked to the assigned plot

steps.what: Total the captured tree tallies by the actual required plot and category
inputs: Declared plot and category grouping rules
outputs: Draft tree tally totals and entries lacking a required category

steps.what: Check the complete final tally against actual captured entries and resolve missing or duplicated entries
inputs: Original field observations and tally entries

steps.what: Save the exact checked tree tally in the existing field record
inputs: Exact final tally checked in s4

tasks.design: Use native {OPS_SYSTEM} tally totals or {SPREADSHEET} grouping formulas on the actual entries captured by the worker. Keep tree examination, count capture and complete final tally checking with the worker before saving the exact final record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual subtotaling adds work after actual trees have already been counted and recorded.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tally forms or spreadsheet totals can apply explicit grouping rules without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying the correct tree, recording the correct observation and detecting missed or duplicated field entries remain manual.
tasks.human_edge: The worker connects the tally to the actual trees and plot.

ambition.what: Reduce arithmetic handling in existing field tally work.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0-1 for field-form access and worker consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: field-form totals and spreadsheet grouping formulas can sum captured tree counts by declared categories.

assumptions: Unmeasured tally episode with actual manual subtotaling. Shares are independent of the prompt prior. This is not an image-based tree counter or an estimate from timber volume.
s1 and s2 count actual tree examination, count production and record capture; no free clean feed is assumed. Missing or doubtful observations require field resolution in s4, not inferred counts.

Use existing form totals first. s3 replaces actual manual summation only; an existing equivalent auto-total is baseline and earns no additional saving. No paper-to-digital transcription saving is assumed.
s4 includes complete actual final tally checking. Save is effectively immediate and earns no saving. No separate report or external submission is bundled into saving.
Gross 15 minus 2 incremental upkeep gives 13 net per 100 baseline focal hours.
research_questions: Does the existing field application already total the required categories?

already_counted.description: Retained actual source capture and complete tally verification

incremental.description: Maintain category rules and check totals after field-form changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete tree tally checked in s4; changed entries require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 15 manual subtotal hours removed, minus 2 upkeep = 13 net. No gain is claimed from existing automatic totals or faster physical tree counting.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Locate the current authorized regulations for camping, vehicles, fires, buildings or sanitation
inputs: Actual visitor issue or observed site condition
outputs: Relevant current rule text and authority limits

steps.what: Assess the actual situation and check the final explanation or permitted enforcement response against the current rule
inputs: Actual observed conduct and visitor account
outputs: Checked situation-specific explanation or permitted response

steps.what: Explain or enforce the applicable regulations with the visitor within actual authority
inputs: Checked current explanation or permitted response from s2
outputs: Visitor receives the explanation or permitted response; unresolved matters go to the supervisor

tasks.design: Provide a native index of the current authorized site regulations in {DOCS}. The worker checks the actual situation and final response, then explains or enforces the rule personally within actual authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct current rule can interrupt a visitor interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: A maintained index and current-version labels can shorten retrieval without generating legal interpretations.
tasks.still_hard: The worker must judge the actual situation, communicate clearly and stay within authority.
tasks.human_edge: The worker responds to the visitor and changing site conditions.

ambition.what: Make existing authorized rules easier to retrieve.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed approved documents can reduce rule retrieval while leaving explanation and enforcement with the authorized worker.

assumptions: Unmeasured live visitor episode, not a baseline of formal citations or penalties; shares are independent of the prompt prior.
The site authority produces and maintains the approved rules. s1 counts actual retrieval and current-version checking; s2 counts situation assessment and the actual final-response check.

No incident report, citation record, external notice or penalty transaction is established in this episode. If one is actually required, its preparation, final check and gated issuance must be shown rather than assumed free.

The live action is separately gated by the actual final response in s2. New facts or a changed response require renewed checking. Authority limits remain manual and unresolved matters go to the supervisor; no automatic legal decision is proposed.
Existing signs or readily available rules may remove the lookup opportunity. Gross 4.5 minus 1 upkeep gives 3.5 net per 100 baseline focal hours.
unknowns: Actual lookup effort and worker authority
Whether a particular episode requires a separate formal record
research_questions: Which visitor questions require lookup rather than direct use of existing signs?

already_counted.description: Retained rule retrieval, situation assessment and final-response checking

incremental.description: Maintain the worker's approved-rule index and verify changed versions

approvals.approved_version: Exact situation-specific explanation or permitted response checked against current rules in s2; changed facts or response require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 15 times 30% = 4.5 gross, minus 1 upkeep = 3.5 net. Live assessment, explanation and enforcement remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify and remove diseased or undesirable trees

steps.what: Check the supervisor's actual tree-selection instructions and relevant approved identification reference
inputs: Approved tree identification and site instructions
outputs: Current selection instructions and reference available

steps.what: Identify actual diseased or undesirable trees and resolve uncertain selections with the supervisor
inputs: Authorized selection instructions and approved reference
outputs: Confirmed trees within the authorized removal assignment

steps.what: Perform the actual authorized tree removal using power saws or hand saws under existing work procedures
inputs: Actual equipment, site conditions and existing work procedures

tasks.design: Make the existing supervisor-approved identification reference easier to retrieve in {DOCS}. Keep actual tree identification, supervisor resolution and physical removal with the trained worker under existing procedures.
tasks.previous_blocker: An approved reference may be difficult to find when checking an uncertain tree selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document shortcuts can expose the existing reference without a new recognition system.
tasks.still_hard: Actual tree condition, uncertain identification and physical removal depend on the site and trained people.
tasks.human_edge: The worker connects instructions to the actual tree and stops uncertain selections for supervisor resolution.

ambition.what: Reduce reference retrieval in existing authorized removal work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document shortcuts can reduce retrieval of an existing approved identification reference without automating tree identification or removal.

assumptions: Unmeasured identification-and-removal episode with actual reference retrieval; shares are independent of the prompt prior.
The supervisor supplies the actual work assignment and approved reference. s1 counts worker retrieval and checking; s2 counts actual identification and resolution. No free tree diagnosis is assumed.
No new tree-removal procedure, equipment control, recognition model or automatic removal authorization is proposed. The physical work is retained in full.
No required inventory update or post-removal report is established here, so none is invented. An actual required tree record would need capture, final checking and its own gated commit shown.
An existing reference already at hand earns no additional saving. Gross 2 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 1.5 net per 100 baseline focal hours.
research_questions: Is the approved reference already available at the work site?

already_counted.description: Retained reference retrieval and current-instruction checking

incremental.description: Keep the existing approved-reference shortcut current

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 10 times 20% = 2 gross, minus 0.5 upkeep = 1.5 net. Identification and physical removal retain all their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Supervisors supply current instructions and resolve uncertain field decisions.
role.ambitious_version: A field worker with easier access to existing instructions and less tally arithmetic, while retaining actual observation, conversations and physical conservation work.
